readme:
AITU Career diploma project management.

Repository: https://github.com/vbl0-0/AITU-Career

18 repository issues (#1–#18) were migrated on 22 October 2026 from the saved YouTrack export (AITU-1–AITU-18). Original descriptions, acceptance criteria, priorities, due dates and planned owners are preserved. Original export date: 19 October 2026; live YouTrack changes after that date were not reverified.

Workflow: To Do → In Progress → Review → Done. Each issue has a Priority, Due date, Planned owner and YouTrack ID. Use the Board for progress and Tasks and Deadlines for planning.

Team assignments: Ayadil (@vbl0-0), nine issues; Zhan (@igiiaw), nine issues. Both names are planning roles, not claims of completed individual contributions.

Link actual branches, commits and pull requests to issues. Move an issue to Done only after its acceptance criteria are met and evidence/review is linked. Creating tasks does not establish historical contributions or supervisor approval.

Submission deadline: 24 October 2026 before 18:00 (UTC+5). November evaluation tasks retain their later deadlines. Confirm the use of GitHub Projects as the tracker alternative with the supervisor.

The board and issue pages are public for read access. Supervisor review, actual contribution history and submission evidence remain separate requirements.
